## ParamExp.Param property

Only one of these is set at a time, or neither with `LangZsh` when the name is omitted. even if that would be mildly annoying to non-Zsh users.

Null preserves the upstream absence of this component.

**Signature:**

```typescript
Param: Lit | null;
```
